1.c4 e5 2.Nc3 Nf6 3.Nf3 Nc6 4.e3 Bb4 5.Q.strategy: Moves the attacked knight into the centre, where it hits the bishop on b4 and the knight on f6. If Black trades on d5, the recapture with the c-pawn attacks the knight on c6 and gives White space in the centre.

Leaves the strong knight on d5 alone and puts a second guard on e5, so that the trade on b4, which pulls the c6 knight away, does not leave the pawn short. Black keeps the bishop and the tension; the cost is that White decides when to cash in on b4 or f6.
